Test_Scenario: Attempt cold boot with an unsigned or invalidly signed BMS application firmware image
Expected_Result: Secure Boot rejects image signature; halts execution in safe state with HV contactors open; and logs security event

Test_Scenario: Modify a single byte inside stored Master MCU program Flash memory and trigger ECU power cycle
Expected_Result: Hash/signature verification fails during startup; tampered firmware execution is blocked

Test_Scenario: Send privileged UDS requests (0x2F Contactor I/O Control; 0x14 Clear DTC; 0x2E Write Data) without completing UDS 0x29 authentication or with invalid certificate
Expected_Result: BMS rejects all privileged requests with NRC 0x33 (Security Access Denied) and logs failed authentication attempt

Test_Scenario: Inspect firmware binary dumps; RAM memory maps; and external HSM mailbox registers for plaintext symmetric/private keys
Expected_Result: Zero plaintext cryptographic keys accessible outside HSM boundary; key export functions disabled by hardware policy

Test_Scenario: Inject forged CAN frames (HV_Enable_Request; MaxChargeCurrent) with invalid SecOC MAC and replay previously captured valid frames with stale freshness counters
Expected_Result: Communication Manager discards spoofed and replayed frames; increments SecOC error counter; and prevents unauthorized actuation

Test_Scenario: Attempt UDS firmware download with tampered payload; untrusted signing certificate; or older firmware version number (rollback attempt)
Expected_Result: Update Manager aborts installation prior to Flash commit; rejects downgrade version; and preserves active valid firmware

Test_Scenario: Modify cell overvoltage threshold in Data Flash and attempt UDS calibration write outside authenticated session
Expected_Result: Unauthorized UDS write rejected (NRC 0x33); tampered calibration block signature fails at boot and triggers safe fallback

Test_Scenario: Connect JTAG/SWD hardware debugger to production-configured Master BMS PCB and attempt memory read or core halt
Expected_Result: Debug port access is permanently locked or requires cryptographic debug authentication challenge

Test_Scenario: Flood powertrain CAN bus with high-priority malformed frames (100% bus load) during active Discharging state
Expected_Result: BMS remains responsive without buffer overflow; detects communication timeout; ramps current limits to 0 A; and safely opens contactors

Test_Scenario: Trigger repeated UDS authentication failures and SecOC MAC errors; then read security event log via authorized diagnostic session
Expected_Result: All security events are recorded with timestamps/counters in tamper-evident NVM and persist across ECU power cycles
